rationale: C11 plausibly supplied a material drafting template for the child's core implementation paragraph. Both use the same compact sequence: report an order taking additional steps regarding an existing national emergency; delegate authority to Treasury to take actions, adopt rules and regulations, and employ presidential IEEPA powers as necessary to implement the order; then direct all executive departments and agencies to take appropriate measures within their authority to implement it. C06 and C12 more closely match the child's three-official consultation structure, including the Attorney General, but their remaining phrasing is less distinctive and appears to reflect the same recurring sanctions-letter form.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby report that I have issued an Executive Order (the "order") with respect to transnational criminal organizations that takes additional steps to deal with the national emergency
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby report that I have issued the enclosed Executive Order (the "order") with respect to North Korea. The order takes further steps with respect to the national emergency
shared_material.explanation: Parallel opening construction reporting an enclosed order aimed at taking further steps under an existing national emergency.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The authorities ... are delegated to the Secretary of the Treasury ... and the Secretary of the Treasury is authorized to take such actions, including adopting rules and regulations, and to employ all powers granted to the President by IEEPA, as may be necessary to implement the order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have delegated to the Secretary of the Treasury the authority ... to take such actions, including the adoption of rules and regulations, and to employ all powers granted to the President by IEEPA ... as may be necessary to implement the order.
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim delegation and implementation machinery, including the comparatively distinctive wording "adopting/adoption of rules and regulations" and "necessary to implement the order."

shared_material.child_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies are directed to take all appropriate measures within their authority to implement the order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I also directed all executive departments and agencies to take all appropriate measures within their authority to implement the order.
shared_material.explanation: Essentially identical interagency implementation clause, including "executive departments and agencies" and the verb "implement."
